summary: FestyVille iteration 3 SimulationOverlay tested end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844). All 6 listed flows pass: (1) RUN FESTIVAL with a ready building immediately shows simulation-overlay (≈0.13s) and NOT the results modal; (2) results modal (simulation-results-modal) appears at ~6.10s with a letter grade and 5 breakdown bars; (3) with no ready buildings, the existing 'Festival Cancelled' alert fires and overlay never mounts; (4) HUD / planning banner / BUILD drawer / RUN button remain interactive after the simulation flow; (5) overlay unmounts before the modal so they never visually overlap; (6) simulate API unchanged from v2 (verified via curl: grade=F, breakdown, rewards, state).

issues: Title 'HEAR THE CROWD' / 'THE GATES OPEN' clips slightly under the HUD top-hud row on a 390x844 device because the HUD is rendered above the modal at z-index of the layout, while the Modal overlay starts at the screen top. Cosmetic only — text is still legible. Consider raising title top from '12%' or adding insets.top padding so the chant never overlaps the C-day chip.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses pointerEvents='none' prop on Animated.View — still triggers the old 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' RN-Web console warning carried over from v2. Migrate to style={{ pointerEvents:'none' }}. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional polish: bump title vertical offset in SimulationOverlay so the chant clears the top HUD chips on small phones (or render the title using insets.top).
Optional cleanup: migrate pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents in SimulationOverlay.tsx to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.

Consider hiding the still-visible isometric grid+building behind the overlay during simulation (currently the SVG mini-map sits inside the modal so the live game grid behind the modal is also faintly visible through the 92% black scrim).
critical_code_review_comments: SimulationOverlay.tsx (~423 lines) is well within size limits and isolates animation state correctly. The useMemo recomputes agent paths whenever `visible` flips, so each Run Festival press regenerates a fresh crowd seed — good.

Race protection: pendingResultRef gates onComplete -> setSimResult/setSimOpen, so if the API resolves before 5.5s the modal still waits for the overlay to finish; if it resolves after, onComplete fires but won't open the modal until the result lands. Verified the second branch works (modal appeared at ~6.10s vs overlay duration 5500ms).
Error path on simulate(): on API failure setSimAnimating(false) is called and the Festival Cancelled alert is shown — but pendingResultRef stays null which is correct, no zombie modal.

Backend simulate unchanged from v2 — confirmed via curl: returns {grade, composite, breakdown:{stage_score,crowd_flow,vendor_coverage,utility_coverage,aesthetic}, rewards, penalty, state} and resets cycle/day/genre/lineup.
seed_data_creation: Two disposable players seeded via curl against the public API: TEST_p_test_overlay_* (genre=edm, food_truck speeded to ready at (2,2)) for the happy path, and TEST_p_test_empty_* (fresh, no buildings) for the cancellation path. PIDs were injected into localStorage under key 'festyville.player_id' before reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://festival-builder-2.preview.emergentagent.com (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). The web client uses AsyncStorage->localStorage key 'festyville.player_id'. Seed flow for overlay testing: GET /api/state/{pid} -> POST /api/state/{pid}/set_genre {genre:'edm'} -> POST .../place {catalog_id:'food_truck',x:2,y:2} -> POST .../speedup {building_id:<id from previous response>}. Then page.goto, set localStorage, reload, wait_for_selector('[data-testid="btn-run-festival"]', timeout=40000). Tap RUN FESTIVAL; overlay testID=simulation-overlay must appear instantly and modal testID=simulation-results-modal appears ~5.5-6.5s later. Note: simulate() does NOT clear buildings (only resets cycle/day/genre/lineup), so to test the 'no ready buildings' path you must use a brand-new PID rather than reusing a post-simulate player. There is one harmless extra 'null' alert pushed during initial Expo bundle load — filter on 'Festival Cancelled' substring rather than checking exact alert array length.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all flows green; only cosmetic polish suggestions filed.
